fields.field: AVDD bulk for U1 (AD3552R pin 19). Basis: TPS7A4901 needs >=2.2uF effective, TI recommends 10uF; AD3552R AVDD current is constant (22mA typ, 28.5mA max) so the job is HF noise (AC PSRR 80dB @1kHz, 43dB @1MHz). Place within a few mm of pin 19 with a direct ground via. A 10uF X7R can lose 30-50% at 5V bias; 0805 footprint chosen for margin: confirm effective C from the vendor bias curve. Verify AVDD ripple at the pin during bring-up; add 1uF or a ferrite if 500kHz switching noise is seen.
